title: Tiny, cute lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hanging hook and handle arc -->
  <path d='M50 6 C42 6 36 12 36 20' fill='none' stroke='#9ad8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 20 C64 12 58 6 50 6' fill='none' stroke='#9ad8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='3' fill='#c8ecff'/>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <path d='M30 26 L70 26 L64 34 L36 34 Z' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <rect x='34' y='22' width='32' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffe89a'/>
  <!-- glass body with warm glow -->
  <rect x='33' y='34' width='34' height='38' rx='6' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <rect x='37' y='38' width='26' height='30' rx='5' fill='#fff0b0'/>
  <!-- little flame -->
  <path d='M50 44 C46 50 45 55 50 61 C55 55 54 50 50 44 Z' fill='#ff8c2e'/>
  <path d='M50 50 C48 54 48 57 50 60 C52 57 52 54 50 50 Z' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <!-- corner bars on glass -->
  <rect x='33' y='34' width='4' height='38' rx='2' fill='#e0a030'/>
  <rect x='63' y='34' width='4' height='38' rx='2' fill='#e0a030'/>
  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <path d='M36 72 L64 72 L70 80 L30 80 Z' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='32' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffe89a'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='38' y='83' width='8' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#e0a030'/>
  <rect x='54' y='83' width='8' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#e0a030'/>
</svg>
